Sergio,

- Thu Mar 25, 10:30–11:00

- Fri Mar 26, 09:00–09:30

If none of those work you can pick a time here: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/30min. Also, can you confirm your preferred time zone and whether you want SSO+data-retention covered up front?
